items.briefing:
Two security issues worth knowing about today: a newly discovered vulnerability in Metabase, a popular business analytics tool used by many organisations, is being actively exploited and could affect a wide range of businesses — if your organisation uses Metabase, check with your IT team urgently. Separately, two iOS exploits called Coruna and DarkSword are spreading globally, meaning iPhone and iPad users should ensure their devices are fully updated.

OpenAI has also flagged that its AI system Astra may be approaching a level where it could assist in serious cyberattacks, a reminder that AI-related threats are evolving quickly. **Practical tip:** Check your iPhone or iPad for available software updates today and install them promptly.

featured.title: Cyber incidents hit 71% of Australian organisations as AI reshapes the threat landscape, MinterEllison report
featured.quote: Record 71% of Australian organisations hit by cyber incidents as AI reshapes threat landscape.
